summary: NI-DAQ card behavior. NidaqManager is always constructed (even with no DAQ — use simulation=true).

fields.label: Timer counter channel
fields.tip: Counter generating the pulse train (detectionRateHz, 1 MHz by default) the point detectors (APD/PMT) sample on, e.g. Dev1/ctr2 -- one no detector ctrInputLine uses. Integer N is also accepted and translated to Dev1/ctr{N}. Required on rigs with a point detector.

fields.label: Start trigger
fields.tip: Enable start-trigger sync between AO/AI/DO/counter tasks.

fields.label: Simulation mode
fields.tip: Allow NI-DAQ commands without physical hardware (no-op).

fields.label: Detection rate (Hz)
fields.tip: Rate of the timer pulse train the point detectors sample on. null = 1000000 (1 MHz), as it always was. Must be a whole multiple of scan.sampleRate; a PMT's analog input is also limited by the driver's ai_max_single_chan_rate (2 MS/s on a PCIe-6363).
